name: Kyonyuu to Ponite to Baka Soudatsusen ~Cosplay Hyakkaryouran! Yuuwaku no Jitsugi Shidou~
original_name: 巨乳とポニテとバカ争奪戦 ～コスプレ百花繚乱! 誘惑の実技指導～
source:
Akihisa Yoshii one morning was confronted with a big problem.

Two girls seemed to be under the impression that he liked them!
Thinking it could only be a trap or a prank, he talked to them.

Aki: "I don't know what you've heard, but..."
Mizuki: "Oh Aki, I can't stand it any more!"
Minami: "Me neither! I can't control myself!"

With their cheeks flushed red, they pushed him down. And so it began.

Stalker sex in days of indulgence. How will you handle it?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE061182.html]DLsite English[/url]]
